topic: Power seat suddenly won't move? Don't assume the motor's dead yet.

beats.narration: Power seat suddenly won't move? Don't assume the motor's dead yet.
beats.visualPrompt: Interior shot of a driver's seat and door panel, static-mounted low-angle camera showing the seat track and switch panel on the seat's side, dim garage lighting, slight handheld-style micro-shake for tension.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: No hum, no click, nothing at all when you press the switch — that's the first clue.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a power-seat switch/toggle panel, static hold, subtle push-in; cut to the seat sitting motionless in frame.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: One clue: a blown fuse or a corroded connector under the seat can look identical to a dead motor.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: a vehicle fuse box panel open, one blown fuse highlighted among a row of intact ones, workbench lighting, slow push-in on the blown fuse.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Chase the wrong part first, and you can end up paying for a motor you didn't need.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro cutaway shot on a seat-track wiring harness connector with visible corrosion/oxidation on the pins, dim shop-bay lighting, static hold, subtle grain to suggest age.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Don't guess which one it is before you check.
beats.visualPrompt: Wide shot of a multimeter clipped onto a wiring harness near the seat track (tool visible, mounted/clipped, no hand in frame), shop bay softly blurred behind.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Worth checking before you replace the wrong part. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold. Real logo and CTA text composited in post, not AI-generated.
